description_en: Submits an integration pipeline task by OAQueryId
description_zh: 根据OAQueryId提交集成管道任务
name: SubmitPipelineById

fields.help_en: The ID of the project to which the integration pipeline task belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务所属项目ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en:
The current operating environment. Valid values:

DEV: the development environment.
PROD: the production environment
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: The node ID of the integration task scheduling node. You can specify any one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成任务调度节点nodeId查询，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId设置任意一个即可
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: The primary key ID of the integration pipeline. You can specify any one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成管道主键pipelineId查询，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId设置任意一个即可
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: The file ID of the integration task. You can specify any one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId
fields.help_zh: 支持使用集成任务文件fileId查询，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId设置任意一个即可
fields.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The ID used to query the pipeline task
parameters.name: query_id
